# GraftM
```{r generate graftM command}

S3_package = "/scratch/groups/dekas/OC17_metagenomics_2022/S3.gpkg"
input_fasta = paste0(rootdir, "RSGsorts_prodigal/faa/merged_sequences.faa")
output_dir = paste0(rootdir, "RSGsorts_rpS3/graftM/")
threads <- 20

dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

graftM_command <- paste(
  "graftM graft",
  "--forward", input_fasta,
  "--output_directory", output_dir,
  "--graftm_package", S3_package,
  "--threads", threads
)

# Write the command to a shell script file
sink(paste(rootdir, "sh_scripts/graftM.sh", sep = ""))
cat("sbatch -J graftM -c 20 --mem-per-cpu 16G -p serc -t 160:00:00 --wrap '", graftM_command, "'")
sink()
file.show(paste(rootdir,"sh_scripts/graftM.sh", sep = ""))
```

```{r parse graftM results}
graftM = read_tsv(paste0(rootdir, "/RSGsorts_rpS3/graftM/merged_sequences/merged_sequences_read_tax.tsv"), col_names = c("sequence_ID", "graftM_taxonomy"))

graftM <- graftM %>%
  mutate(
    file_name = str_extract(sequence_ID, ".*(?=_prodigalORFs)"),  #Capture everything before "prodigalORFs"
    contig = str_extract(sequence_ID, ".*(?=_[^_]+$)") #captures everything before the last underscore and following digits
  )

#merge graftM and metadata to ID which sample is what condition and sort
metadata_unique <- metadata %>%
  distinct(file_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

graftM_formatted <- graftM %>%
  left_join(metadata_unique, by = "file_name") %>%
  select(file_name, sequence_ID, contig, sample_type, depth_m, amplified, graftM_taxonomy)

write.csv(file = paste0(rootdir, "/RSGsorts_rpS3/graftM/formatted_graftM_results.csv"), graftM_formatted, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r compare against MAGs and visualize}
genomes = read.csv(paste0(rootdir, "/genome_info_summary.csv"))
genomes$X = NULL

genomes_mini = select(genomes, c(genome, classification, drep_rep))

genomes_mini <- genomes_mini %>%
  mutate(
    file_name = str_extract(genome, ".*(?=_[^_]*$)")
  )

genomes_mini <- genomes_mini %>%
  left_join(metadata_unique, by = "file_name") %>%
  select(file_name, genome, drep_rep, sample_type, depth_m, amplified, classification)

#active and inactive MAGs from coverM mapping in mag processing rmd
active_MAGs_2202m = c("Orca-CTD5BTL4_S510_23", "Orca-CTD10BTL6_S511_13")
active_MAGs_2224m = c("Orca-CTD10BTL6_S511_13")
other_MAGs_2224m = c("Orca-CTD10BTL6_S511_13")

active_rpS3_2202m = graftM_formatted %>%
  filter(sample_type == "Active" & depth_m == "2202") %>%
  pull(sequence_ID)

active_rpS3_2224m = graftM_formatted %>%
  filter(sample_type == "Active" & depth_m == "2224") %>%
  pull(sequence_ID)

other_rpS3_2224m = graftM_formatted %>%
  filter(sample_type == "Other" & depth_m == "2224") %>%
  pull(sequence_ID)

inactive_rpS3_2224m = graftM_formatted %>%
  filter(sample_type == "Inactive" & depth_m == "2224") %>%
  pull(sequence_ID)

# Prepare presence/absence data for each list
# Step 1: Combine all lists into a single data frame
combined_data <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(entry = active_MAGs_2202m, condition = "active_MAGs_2202m", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(entry = active_MAGs_2224m, condition = "active_MAGs_2224m", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(entry = other_MAGs_2224m, condition = "other_MAGs_2224m", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(entry = active_rpS3_2202m, condition = "active_rpS3_2202m", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(entry = active_rpS3_2224m, condition = "active_rpS3_2224m", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(entry = other_rpS3_2224m, condition = "other_rpS3_2224m", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(entry = inactive_rpS3_2224m, condition = "inactive_rpS3_2224m", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
)

if ("genome" %in% colnames(genomes_mini)) {
  genomes_mini <- genomes_mini %>%
    filter(!is.na(genome)) %>%  # Ensure no missing values in the genome column
    dplyr::rename(entry = genome)  # Use dplyr::rename explicitly
} else {
  stop("Column 'genome' not found in genomes_mini.")
}

if ("sequence_ID" %in% colnames(graftM_formatted)) {
  graftM_formatted <- graftM_formatted %>%
    filter(!is.na(sequence_ID)) %>%  # Ensure no missing values in the genome column
    dplyr::rename(entry = sequence_ID)  # Use dplyr::rename explicitly
} else {
  stop("Column 'sequence_ID' not found in graftM_taxonomy")
}

if ("graftM_taxonomy" %in% colnames(graftM_formatted)) {
  graftM_formatted <- graftM_formatted %>%
    filter(!is.na(graftM_taxonomy)) %>%  # Ensure no missing values in the genome column
    dplyr::rename(classification = graftM_taxonomy)  # Use dplyr::rename explicitly
} else {
  stop("Column 'graftM_taxonomy' not found in graftM_taxonomy")
}


#Add taxonomy information

#rename some things
combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  # Join with genomes_mini for MAG lists, renaming genome_ID to entry
  left_join(genomes_mini %>% select(entry, classification), by = "entry") %>%
  # Join with graftM_formatted for rpS3 lists, renaming sequence_ID to entry
  left_join(graftM_formatted %>% select(entry, classification), by = "entry")

# Replace any NA in the classification columns with the other source
combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(classification = coalesce(classification.x, classification.y)) %>%
  select(entry, condition, classification)

presence_data <- combined_data %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition,
    values_from = entry,
    values_fn = list(entry = ~paste(., collapse = ", ")), # Combine multiple entries with a comma
    values_fill = list(entry = NA)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -classification, 
    names_to = "condition", 
    values_to = "entry"
  ) %>%
  mutate(present = !is.na(entry))

presence_data$classification = gsub("Root; ", "", presence_data$classification)

presence_data$classification = gsub(" ", "", presence_data$classification)

presence_data <- presence_data %>%
  separate(classification, into = c("domain", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species"), sep = ";", fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(
    phylum = sub("p__", "", phylum),
    class = sub("c__", "", class),
    order = sub("o__", "", order),
    family = sub("f__", "", family),
    genus = sub("g__", "", genus),
    species = sub("s__", "", species)
  )

presence_data <- presence_data %>%
  mutate(
    split_condition = str_split(condition, "_"),
    RSG_sort = sapply(split_condition, function(x) x[1]),
    sequence_type = sapply(split_condition, function(x) x[2]),
    depth = sapply(split_condition, function(x) x[3])
  ) %>%
  select(-split_condition)
```

```{r plot the data}

classes_with_both <- presence_data %>%
  filter(sequence_type %in% c("MAGs", "rpS3") & present == TRUE) %>%
  distinct(class, sequence_type) %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  summarise(has_both = n_distinct(sequence_type) == 2) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 2: Join this information back to the main data to create sequence_overlap
presence_data <- presence_data %>%
  left_join(classes_with_both, by = "class") %>%
  mutate(
    # Assign 'Both' if class has both MAGs and rpS3 and is present
    sequence_overlap = case_when(
      has_both & present == TRUE ~ "Both",
      sequence_type == "MAGs" & present == TRUE ~ "MAGs",
      sequence_type == "rpS3" & present == TRUE ~ "rpS3",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Assign NA if not matching
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-has_both)  # Drop the temporary column used for checking

plot = ggplot(presence_data %>% filter(!is.na(entry)), aes(x = class, y = depth)) +  # Remove NA in entry column only
  geom_point(aes(shape = sequence_overlap), size = 3) +  # Change shape based on sequence_overlap
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("MAGs" = 1, "rpS3" = 8, "Both" = 19)) +  # Add third shape for both sequence types
  labs(x = "Taxonomic Class", y = "Depth") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  ) +
  facet_grid(~RSG_sort, scales = "free") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = c("2224m","2202m"))

plot

ggsave(filename = paste0(rootdir, "/plots/rpS3vMAGs.pdf"), plot = plot)
```
